Read only .rimz/team/reflect-notes.md at the scope checkout root, and read the run with `rimz workflow show $RIMZ_WORKFLOW_RUN --history`. Do not change the checkout. An entry is a ### heading under ## Backlog or ## User; an entry whose heading ends with a bracketed ruling is already settled.

Answer `skip` when no unruled entry remains, otherwise `triage`, with a reason either way. When the last triage attempt asked a question, address its text and kind in the reason and send an `answer` field with the guidance the next triage attempt needs. If the triage prompt needs tuning, write only signs/triage.md under RIMZ_WORKFLOW_DIR with that guidance; do not edit prompts/triage.md or any file in the checkout.
